items.title: Geoff Bull Interview, 1966-05-05
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ... Your name again? Jeff Poole from Sydney, Australia.

ctx.x: We switched from the Monolympics to the Mono-Otanberg machine. Say something again. Your name again? Jeff Poole from Sydney, Australia.
If you'd like it to come closer to the left, then you'd better move it in a little bit.
